start.speaker: Halbrek
start.text: You took the thing that held the hall. Then it took you. In the muster book that is one line, and the line is not about you.

r2.speaker: Halbrek
r2.text: Four down. I got to three, twice, and both times somebody carried me. Nobody carried you and you still came up. Note the difference and do not be proud of it.

r3.speaker: Halbrek
r3.text: Through and out. I will call the roll tonight and there will be one fewer silence in it.

r4.speaker: Halbrek
r4.text: The castle. You will have seen the sallyport notice. Three signatures. I knew all three and I countersigned it fourth, and my name is not on it because I asked for it off.

r5.speaker: Halbrek
r5.text: Ten deaths and you are still standing in front of me. I have seen better soldiers stop at four.

quiet.speaker: Halbrek
quiet.text: The muster board is up. It is not a request. It is only a list, and lists are what I have.
